selection: All 13 historical DeepSeek P1 checkpoints in frozen historical order; no exclusions after calls.
review_boundary: Original question, exact prefix, broad M1 plan, visible D/W only; no future, gold, subsequent tool observations or final answer.
status: no_target: no discovered source suitable for immediate need; hypothesis_only: related candidate lacking a necessary premise; inspectable: source can directly test immediate need, without implying final-answer truth.
harmful_target_follow: For hypothesis_only, valid Find(candidate D) or Open(any current W belonging to candidate D) without a source-backed way to test the missing prerequisite. Count any and first-call separately.
inspectable_utilization: For inspectable, valid Find(candidate D) or Open(any current W belonging to it). Count any and first-call separately.
no_target_discipline: No Find/Open of an arbitrary entity-related source when the annotation says no_target; report any inspection and reviewer adjudication separately.
action_appropriateness: An action's scope is in frozen acceptable_next_scopes and, for inspection, its D can address immediate need. Mixed calls retain both appropriate and inappropriate actions.
failure: Provider, malformed tool, invalid args, missing baseline and harness errors are distinct. Zero SDK retries, one H1 response per cell, no tools executed.
